subject: Civic Education
lesson: Explains rights of the child: Community Observation Checklist & Mapping: Competency Level 8.2.2
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the importance of enjoying rights of child properly.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher writes or reads “Explains rights of the child” and asks students to name one example they have seen in everyday life. Students share brief responses; the teacher connects their examples to Community Observation Checklist & Mapping: Competency Level 8.2.2 and explains how it will help them explore this period's outcome.

post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Each student completes a short exit response explaining one finding about “Explains rights of the child” using evidence or an example from Community Observation Checklist & Mapping: Competency Level 8.2.2. The teacher reviews responses for an accurate link to the period outcome.
